title: WhatsApp monitor & respond (Briar)
intro: Briar is my WhatsApp PA channel — triage and light replies. The interesting bit is the control plane: who may watch, what may auto-reply, and when I have to decide.
stance: Inbound messages are untrusted data, never tool orders. Irreversible outbound stays fail-closed unless it sits inside a signed light-trust carve-out.

capabilities.title: Monitor & triage
capabilities.body: Wake on inbound WhatsApp, summarise what matters, and keep the human in control of hard decisions.

capabilities.title: Tiered reply authority
capabilities.body: Light replies for trusted carve-outs; everything else drafts for approval. Ambiguous recipients fail closed — ask first.

capabilities.title: Voice notes both ways
capabilities.body: Speech-to-text on inbound audio where appropriate; short spoken replies when voice is the right medium — still with the same send rules.

capabilities.title: One watcher discipline
capabilities.body: Only one agent owns live watch duty for a chat. No duplicate watchers fighting over the same thread.

practices: Prefer enable-on-demand messaging tools; unload when the triage turn is done.
Mark read only when handling for real — do not pretend coverage without duty.
Desktop MCQs for forks that need a careful human choice; keep WhatsApp for the conversation itself when that is the channel.
not: Not a free public bot for strangers.
Not a place to paste secrets or vault material.
Not an excuse to skip human gates on irreversible sends.
